narrative_purpose: The cold-open anchor: drops the reader onto a lightless seafloor in front of a whole field of alkaline chimneys, so the chapter's opening observation is something they have seen before any explanation arrives.
subject: A field of roughly a dozen pale porous mineral chimneys of varying heights, from knee-high stubs to tall slender columns, scattered across a dark seafloor. Each taller chimney has an open top with faintly glowing warm fluid rising from it in slow thin plumes that bend sideways in a slow current. The chimney surfaces are rough and honeycombed with small pits.
scene: A wide stretch of lightless abyssal floor, dark fine sediment between the chimneys, the field receding into layered haze until individual chimneys become only faint pale suggestions in the distance.
camera: A wide low establishing shot from just above the seafloor, looking across the field so the near chimneys are large at the left and the field recedes toward the right.
light: No external light at all. Each chimney's rising fluid glows faintly from within in pale teal, lighting only its own upper surfaces and the water immediately around it; the sediment between them is almost black. Distant chimneys read as dim pale smudges in the haze.
palette: Overwhelmingly void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, chimneys in desaturated pale stone with cool cyan and living-teal rims, the plumes carrying a faint warm amber core close to their vents.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted, the confidence of a scene observed from life in near-total darkness.
detail_level: High texture on the two or three nearest chimneys, mid detail in the middle distance, everything beyond dissolving into flat dark haze.
composition: Horizontal spread with the tallest chimney at the left third, the field receding to the right, a large area of dark empty water above the field for open space.
consistency_notes: Same porous pale mineral chimney look as the cover plate, same cool palette and near-total darkness; the field must read as entirely lifeless — no organisms anywhere, which is the point of the opening.
